description.value: Indigenous-owned Tla-o-qui-aht resort on Pacific Rim Hwy about 3 km from Tofino with exclusive access to tinwis Beach; only 5 tent sites amid mostly RV and cabin accommodation, so book early for this high-demand destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation-owned campground near Tofino with 34 RV sites, 13 mini cabins, and 5 tent sites. Laundry is confirmed on the long-term rentals page ('access to washroom and laundry facilities'); food proximity via FAQ ('3km from town centre — 15-minute bike ride'); reservations via prominent 'Book Online' and phone booking options. Two different phone numbers appear across pages (250-266-5015 on the contact page; 250-725-5015 in the FAQ), and the postal code shown on the website contact page (V0R 2Z0) differs from the OSM tag (V0R 3A0).
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM tag has V0R 3A0; website contact page shows V0R 2Z0.
Multiple conflicting phone numbers on website: contact page and most header instances show 250-266-5015; FAQ page shows 250-725-5015; one header instance shows 1.250.725.4445.
OSM record has no phone number listed, so phone could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, legitimate campground with tent sites, mini cabins, and RV hookups within easy cycling distance of Tofino; a clear and practical stop for touring cyclists on the West Coast.
